newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon to set up liaison office in India.
newsitem.headline: Aegon to set up liaison office in India.

text.p: Aegon NV said on Wednesday it had obtained permission from the Indian authorities to open a liaison office in the Indian capital New Delhi.

Aegon added the Indian government had recently permitted a limited number of foreign insurers to open liaison offices, as a first step towards an anticipated liberalisation of the country's insurance market.
Aegon is the second Dutch insurer within a week to announce it would set up business in India.
Last week, the insurance arm of financial services group ING said it would open a representative office in New Delhi.
Both companies said India, with its population of about 950 million people, offered attractive prospects.
